newsitem.title: USA: US cash crude grades sink on Feb/Mar WTI widening.
newsitem.headline: US cash crude grades sink on Feb/Mar WTI widening.

text.p: U.S. cash crudes failed to sustain a short covering price rally, ending the week slightly weaker for prompt February outright barrels.
Traders said sweet crude grade differentials remained in a weakened state by Friday's close, having suffered a price deflation from a short squeeze in the February/March West Texas Intermediate roll.

Feb WTI closed out around 10 cts weaker at $25.35-45 a barrel, while the Feb/March spread moved out to a wide $1.08 a barrel in late afternoon dealings before ending closer to $1.00, 20 cts higher than morning levels.
